offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and get SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens. 档位：Free 10M tokens；Prototype Development 1B tokens $50 (0.050/1M tokens)；Production Deployment 11B tokens $500 (0.045/1M tokens)。
offerings.price_basis: Prototype Development（Standard key, 0.050/1M tokens, 固定 10,000 tokens/次）
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens!（Toy Experiment 10 Million tokens, Non-commercial use only CC-BY-NC）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（top five results with URLs and contents, LLM-friendly text）
offerings.note: Search mode returns a list of five entries；每请求固定消耗从 10,000 tokens 起，略计费口粮数可为浮动。RPM：无 key 100 / free 100 / premium 1000，平均延迟 2.5s。
